report.clinical_summary: Patient is a man living with HIV who began Biktarvy approximately 4 weeks ago. He reports daily headaches with severe intensity (pressure around head, light sensitivity, can't open eyes) and mild morning nausea, both appearing shortly after treatment initiation. Symptoms affect work concentration, social engagement, and daily tasks. He has not yet discussed symptoms with his doctor. The diagnosis is emotionally challenging; he describes ongoing worry about the future and difficulty imagining long-term management. He has good partner support, has disclosed to partner and close friends, and maintains a focus on health maintenance and 'doing everything in my power to stay healthy.' He shows reasonable understanding of HIV pathophysiology but finds detailed information overwhelming. His treatment beliefs balance perceived necessity with discomfort about side effects and a general preference for minimizing medication use.
